items.quote: ...I never pitch. I turn my statements into questions. Do you recognize this Marina?
items.statement: The presenter turns statements into questions to facilitate client engagement during the presentation.

items.quote: ...your approach, I know that's from one of the the people like one of the countries I can use for sure...
items.statement: It’s crucial to adapt sales approaches based on the cultural background of clients.

items.quote: ...not me telling him, he's telling himself. You see? Do I do anything? Do I force him?
items.statement: The speaker emphasizes the importance of not merely telling clients information but enabling them to conclude on their own.

overview: Sales training insights focused on buyer psychology for real estate agents in Dubai, including client engagement tactics and strategies for effective presentations.
